performance_case.causal_mechanism: A single internally consistent V7 cloud prompt can invoke the normally due canonical heartbeat with the exact server-accepted attestation and preserve durable same-chat Coach delivery without a second clock or cross-task dependency.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only repository prompt-to-contract consistency. It cannot prove platform same-chat binding, one active recurrence, unattended context visibility, heartbeat execution, receipt acceptance, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS value, or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The prompt audit has zero immediate drawdown effect; only later evidence-bound strategies can establish drawdown improvement, while preventing failed research cycles protects evidence continuity rather than market risk.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A false positive could activate a contradictory schedule and lose evidence or Coach delivery cycles; a false negative delays the single cloud clock, so every negative finding must cite an exact listed byte and every platform claim remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: This consistency audit cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL directly, but preventing stale V6 attestation or delivery instructions may reduce failed cloud cycles and shorten time to trustworthy V3 evidence and later strategy decisions.
